182:t_10:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「S-sorry... When $$ＡＧ$$ comes close, I just can't help being scared...」

182:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But $$ナイト$$ $$ジン$$ isn't here right now, you know.」

182:t_10:8.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「...I don't intend to keep relying on $$ジン$$ forever. If $$ミカゲ$$ ever goes after $$ジン$$ again, I'll protect him!」

182:t_10:9.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'll get stronger for that...! I won't lose even to $$ＡＧ$$!」

182:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-an unexpected counterattack...! This is a crisis!」

182:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right, $$ユノハ$$. Don't forget the fighting spirit you had when you used that special attack.)

182:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That strong resolve of yours produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

182:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... the thrill of being overthrown from below is simply irresistible...」

182:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is no need to be so wary. I am only thinking of imparting to you a secret technique for not having nightmares.」

182:t_10:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're just going to try to sell me some shady product through the $$Ｄトレーダー$$, aren't you...!」

182:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How rude! This time it is a 100% natural method, with no side effects, and free of charge!」

182:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you tire out your mind and body by shouting loudly, you will sleep like a log at night!」

182:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, here we go! Let's give it our all again today...!」

182:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no! One more time! Let's give it our all again today...!」

182:t_10:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「I told you I'm not doing it!」

182:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not yet! Let's give it our all again today...!」

182:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That goes both ways! All right, let's give it our all again today...!」

182:t_10:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「No way in hell I'm doing it!」

182:t_10:36.en:
$n
「...You've been noisy for a while now, $$アルト$$.」

182:t_10:40.en:
$$アルト$$
「You... So all that earlier was to make me shout...」

182:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do not worry. As I said earlier, this is a complimentary service.」

182:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then by all means, show that gratitude in a tangible way! Let's give it our all again today...!」

182:t_10:44.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's why I told you I'm not doing it!」

182:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no! Please, I beg you! Let's give it our all again today...!」

182:t_10:46.en:
$$アルト$$
「You really are persistent, aren't you!」

183:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Come back, Ensign $$アルト$$! We haven't given a sortie order!」

183:t_001:0.en:
$$ボビー$$
「What's gotten into you, $$アルト$$, sweetie?!」

183:t_001:1.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Is it stress from not knowing where $$ランカ$$ is?」

183:t_001:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, we stop him. Have Major $$オズマ$$ take command.」

183:t_001:4.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Please wait, Captain! We have a contact on the radar!」

183:t_002:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Scramble! Get them moving fast!」

183:t_003:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Get back! The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s are coming!」

183:t_004:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If you're awake, then get back in fighting shape, fast! Or do you want to die?!」

183:t_004:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「B-Big Sis! It's a starfish, it's gross, it's $$コスモ星丸$$!」

183:t_004:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are those the $$宇宙怪獣$$ from that parallel world everyone's talking about?」

183:t_004:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No... those are living creatures called $$インベーダー#pilot$$s. Well... they're not much different from $$宇宙怪獣$$, though.」

183:t_004:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Who would have thought they would be out even in this frontier.」

183:t_004:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. $$人類銀河同盟$$ has classified the target as a Special Class One hazardous life form.」

183:t_004:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So basically, they're as dangerous as the 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》 that $$レド$$ and the others were fighting.」

183:t_004:12.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Everyone from $$トップレス$$, be careful too. Those are beings called $$バアル$$, just like the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

183:t_004:13.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Understanding a monster like that is out of the question to begin with.」

183:t_004:15.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know. If they intend to annihilate humanity, we will meet them head-on.」

183:t_004:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... Big Bro $$刹那$$ is pretty fired up too, huh?」

183:t_004:17.en:
$$スザク$$
「Don't let your guard down, $$勝平$$. The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s have grown even stronger than they were in the $$再世戦争$$.」

183:t_004:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They are ravenous destroyers... To satisfy their own desires, they evolve, seeking ever more power.」

183:t_004:19.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Now that $$時の牢獄$$ is gone, they are coming from outer space...」

183:t_004:20.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of being destroyed without a fight.」

183:t_004:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since we rejected $$エタニティ・フラット$$, we were prepared to fight $$バアル$$.」

183:t_004:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! I'll make them regret waltzing onto Earth!」

183:t_004:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$n, don't forget the tips for controlling your machine that I taught you.」

183:t_004:25.en:
$$ランド$$
「And the smile I taught you, too!」

183:t_004:27.en:
$$甲児$$
「So $n got coaching from $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$, huh?」

183:t_004:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Watching that kid's recklessness makes you want to step in and help.」
